title: 菊花賞の後に・からっぽの両手

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide both fail to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This loss and the difficulties she faced in training weigh heavily on Narita Taishin, and she breaks from mental and physical exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She confesses that she needs a break from both training and racing.
